description: D-076 (GATE-FAST): repository tooling, registry and unit-manifest paths outside the web root that the web package never builds, imports or configures from: a change to one runs only the tests of the unit that owns it and its dependents (OU-DECOUPLE F4, D-111: the web reader map left with Open University) instead of the full web battery, even when it is a gate.full_battery_globs class. Under the pin (P-46) the gate that runs the web stages is the base tip's, so the PR's tooling is only code under test there. gate.reader_scoped_exclude keeps the full battery for the tooling the web checks themselves read. An empty list is the rollback.
